title: Max opt
description: Modpack that opptimizes minecraft as much as possible
body:
# Max opt

A lightweight template modpack for Minecraft 26.1.2 (Fabric). It contains only optimization mods, leaving you a clean, high-performance base to build your own pack on top of. Add your favorite content mods and keep the smooth framerate.

## What it does

Max opt bundles the most trusted Fabric performance mods, already installed and configured to work together. You get better FPS, lower memory use, faster chunk loading, and longer render distance out of the box, with no content mods getting in the way.



## Included mods

- Sodium and Reese's Sodium Options - rendering engine and improved video settings
- Iris - shader support
- Lithium - general game and tick optimization
- FerriteCore - reduced memory usage
- C2ME - multithreaded chunk loading and generation
- Bobby - chunk caching and extended render distance
- ImmediatelyFast - faster rendering of UI and text
- EntityCulling - skips rendering entities you can't see
- Clumps - groups XP orbs to reduce lag
- StateStream - world hosting - especially effective in singleplayer
- Fabric API, Mod Menu, and Placeholder API - required libraries and utilities

## Notes

Max opt is meant to be modified. Tear it apart, build it up, and make it your own.
